name: sholok-blog
description: Sholok Blog Platform - Full Stack (Server + Frontend)

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "Server,Frontend" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev:only --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix server/admin
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build:admin --prefix server
